summary: The customer inquired about an unknown service fee charge.

intents.keywords: नमस्ते मैं निखिल पांडे बोल रहा हूं। मेरे खाते से ... रहे हैं।

issues.issue: Customer was charged an unknown service fee.

intents.actions of agent: The agent checked the account and identified the charge as a minimum balance fee and initiated a refund request.
intents.resolution: The agent informed the customer that the refund would be processed in five business days.
